portrait_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Solo vertical waist-up character-card portrait of Yotsuba Nakano, short orange bob, bright green ribbon headband with two upright rabbit-ear loops, blue eyes, cream school vest over white collared shirt and green bow tie, from The Quintessential Quintuplets. Faithful recognizable anime design, refined crisp lineart and soft cel shading. Calm attentive expression with a slight character-appropriate smile. Age-appropriate nonsexual teenage student. Full head with generous headroom, centered composition, softly blurred sunlit school interior background. No text, watermark, panels, border or other characters.
Finales Profilbild: happy-Variante mit erweitertem Bildausschnitt; siehe happy-Prompt.
